faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.what_is_answer: {name} is a wallet address belonging to {entity} on the {chain} network.
faq.is_safe: Is this address safe to interact with?
faq.is_safe_answer_safe: {name} is a verified safe address from a well-known entity.
faq.is_safe_answer_neutral: {name} has a neutral risk level. Exercise normal caution.
faq.is_safe_answer_warning: Warning: {name} has been flagged for potential risks. Proceed with caution.

cex.can_deposit: Can I deposit funds to this address?
cex.can_deposit_answer: {name} is an official deposit address for {entity}. Always verify the address on the exchange's official website before sending funds.
cex.how_to_withdraw: How do I withdraw from this exchange?
cex.how_to_withdraw_answer: To withdraw from {entity}, log into your account, navigate to the withdrawal section, enter your destination wallet address, and confirm the transaction following the exchange's security procedures.

dex.what_is_contract_answer: {name} is a smart contract for {entity} decentralized exchange. It enables permissionless token swaps directly on the blockchain.

defi.what_does_it_do: What does this DeFi contract do?
defi.what_does_it_do_answer: {name} is a smart contract for {entity} that enables decentralized financial services on the blockchain.
defi.lending_how: How does lending work on this protocol?
defi.lending_how_answer: {entity} allows users to lend assets to earn interest or borrow against collateral. Interest rates are determined algorithmically based on supply and demand.
defi.bridge_how: How do I use this bridge?
defi.bridge_how_answer: {name} is a bridge contract for {entity}. It allows you to transfer assets between different blockchain networks securely.
defi.staking_how_answer: {entity} allows you to stake your tokens while receiving a liquid derivative token that can be used in other DeFi protocols.

token.what_is_contract_answer: {name} is the official smart contract for this token. Always verify the contract address before interacting.
token.stablecoin_peg: How is this stablecoin's peg maintained?
token.stablecoin_peg_answer: {name} maintains its peg through a combination of reserves, algorithmic mechanisms, or overcollateralization depending on its design.

entity.whale_activity: Why is this whale address notable?
entity.whale_activity_answer: {name} holds a significant amount of cryptocurrency. Tracking whale movements can provide insights into market trends.
entity.multisig_what_answer: {name} is a multi-signature wallet that requires multiple approvals to execute transactions, providing enhanced security.
entity.governance: What is the governance role of this address?
entity.governance_answer: {name} belongs to {entity} and may be involved in protocol governance, treasury management, or community decisions.

risk.why_flagged_answer: {name} has been flagged due to association with malicious activities such as hacks, scams, or sanctions violations. Exercise extreme caution.
risk.what_to_do: What should I do if I've interacted with this address?
risk.what_to_do_answer: If you've sent funds to this address, recovery may not be possible. Check if the receiving protocol has a recovery mechanism, and consider reporting to relevant authorities.

contract.is_verified_answer: You can check if {name} has verified source code on {chain} block explorer. Verified contracts have their source code publicly available for review.
